<p class="owner"><span class="en">Author: Kai Marsh</span><span class="zh">作者：马凯</span></p>

::: {.en}
Each council already pays a price to get rid of a tonne of garbage: the landfill gate fee plus the state levy. That is the benchmark we have to beat. Our price to them is our gate fee **plus** transport to the plant. Pick a plant site, move the gate fee, and each council turns one of three colours:

- **Blue: sends us its waste.** Our price is at least the switching margin (default 10%) below its landfill cost.
- **Yellow: on the fence.** We're cheaper, but by less than the margin, so it doesn't switch yet. These are the councils a small price cut would win.
- **Grey: too expensive.** Landfill is still cheaper.

Hatched areas have no council kerbside data or are out of scope (unincorporated areas, the APY and Maralinga Tjarutja lands, Jervis Bay Territory). The map covers every council in Victoria, NSW, the ACT, South Australia and Tasmania: 311 areas, 305 of them priced. Each priced council has a red-bin tonnage and an average energy content (MJ/kg), so the page shows how much energy a given price wins, not just how many tonnes. The council's waste does not change between sites; the transport cost does. Prices are 2026–27 A\$ per tonne, excluding GST.
:::

::: {.zh}
每个市政目前处理一吨垃圾都要支付填埋处理费加州填埋税，这是我方需要击败的基准价。我方对其报价 = 我方处理费 **加上** 运至工厂的运费。选择厂址并调整处理费后，每个市政显示三种颜色之一：

- **蓝色：会把垃圾交给我方**：我方价格比其填埋成本低至少设定的转换门槛（默认10%）。
- **黄色：观望中**：我方更便宜，但幅度不足门槛，暂不转换；小幅降价即可争取。
- **灰色：太贵**：填埋仍更便宜。

斜线区域无市政路边垃圾数据或不在范围内（非建制区、APY及Maralinga Tjarutja原住民土地、杰维斯湾领地）。地图覆盖维州、新州、首都领地、南澳和塔州全部市政：共311个区域，其中305个参与定价。每个定价市政都有红桶垃圾吨数和平均热值（兆焦/千克），因此本页显示某一价格能争取到的能量，而不仅是吨数。各市政垃圾量不随厂址变化，变化的是运费。价格为2026–27年度澳元/吨，不含GST。
:::

//| echo: false

Inputs = window.Inputs

d3 = window.d3
html = window.htl.html
L = (en, zh) => html`<span class="en">${en}</span><span class="zh">${zh}</span>`
lang = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const f = () => notify(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-lang") || "en");
  f();
  const mo = new MutationObserver(f);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-lang"]});
  return () => mo.disconnect();
})
T = (en, zh) => lang === "zh" ? zh : en
// Cache-busting: Cloudflare caches data files for hours; the page's Last-Modified changes on every deploy
V = "?v=" + encodeURIComponent(document.lastModified)
// d3.autoType, but text columns that look like dates or numbers (e.g. garbage_year "2023-24") stay text
KEEP_TEXT = new Set(["garbage_year", "lga_code", "port", "route_note", "notes", "waste_notes", "tonnage_source", "cv_source"])
csv = path => fetch(path + V).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : "").then(t => d3.csvParse(t, d => { const keep = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d).filter(([k]) => KEEP_TEXT.has(k)).map(([k, v]) => [k, v === "" ? null : v])); return Object.assign(d3.autoType(d), keep); }))
councilsRaw = csv("../data/councils.csv")
freightRaw = csv("../data/council_freight.csv")
geo = fetch("../data/councils.geojson" + V).then(r => r.json())
net = fetch("../data/freight_network.geojson" + V).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : ({type: "FeatureCollection", features: []})).catch(() => ({type: "FeatureCollection", features: []}))
levyHist = csv("../data/levy_history.csv")
// Data contract with work/scripts/merge.py. The banner below lists anything missing.
NEED_C = ["name", "state", "zone", "in_scope", "lon", "lat", "levy_2027", "garbage_t", "tonnage_status", "cv_mj_kg", "organics_service", "organics_coverage"]
NEED_F = ["name", "site", "mode", "road_km", "rail_km", "sea_km", "port", "transfers", "feasible", "legal_flag", "route_note", "bass_strait"]
missingCols = [...NEED_C.filter(k => !councilsRaw.columns.includes(k)).map(k => "councils.csv:" + k), ...NEED_F.filter(k => !freightRaw.columns.includes(k)).map(k => "council_freight.csv:" + k)]
levy2027 = Object.fromEntries(levyHist.filter(d => d.year === 2027).map(d => [d.zone, d.levy]))
// Fallback levies (2026-27, A$/t ex GST) if councils.csv has no levy_2027 column
LEVY_FALLBACK = ({...levy2027, NSW_NOLEVY: 0, ACT: 0, TAS: 70.56})
// A council is priced only if it is in scope and has a tonnage; everything else is drawn hatched ("no data / out of scope")
councils = councilsRaw.map(c => {
  const priced = c.in_scope === 1 && c.tonnage_status !== "none" && Number.isFinite(c.garbage_t) && c.garbage_t > 0;
  return {...c, priced, cv_mj_kg: Number.isFinite(c.cv_mj_kg) ? c.cv_mj_kg : null,
          levy: Number.isFinite(c.levy_2027) ? c.levy_2027 : (LEVY_FALLBACK[c.zone] ?? null)};
})
// Feasible freight options, by council then site
legsBy = d3.group(freightRaw.filter(r => r.feasible === 1), r => r.name, r => r.site)
SITES = [
  {id: "LATROBE", lon: 146.393, lat: -38.271, en: "Latrobe Valley, Vic", zh: "拉筹伯谷（维州）", short: "Latrobe", shortZh: "拉筹伯谷", flag: "ok"},
  {id: "NARROMINE", lon: 148.240, lat: -32.230, en: "Narromine, NSW (not permitted)", zh: "纳罗迈恩（新州，不许可）", short: "Narromine", shortZh: "纳罗迈恩", flag: "blocked"},
  {id: "PORT_AUGUSTA", lon: 137.7874, lat: -32.5429, en: "Port Augusta, SA", zh: "奥古斯塔港（南澳）", short: "Port Augusta", shortZh: "奥古斯塔港", flag: "caution"}
]
siteById = new Map(SITES.map(s => [s.id, s]))
PORTS = [{name: "Port of Melbourne", lon: 144.910, lat: -37.815}, {name: "Port Botany", lon: 151.220, lat: -33.970}, {name: "Port Kembla", lon: 150.900, lat: -34.462},
         {name: "Port of Newcastle", lon: 151.770, lat: -32.910}, {name: "Port Adelaide (Outer Harbor)", lon: 138.485, lat: -34.780}, {name: "Devonport", lon: 146.365, lat: -41.180},
         {name: "Burnie", lon: 145.915, lat: -41.050}, {name: "Grassy (King Island)", lon: 144.060, lat: -40.060}, {name: "Lady Barron (Flinders Island)", lon: 148.250, lat: -40.210}]
routeColor = ({rail_interstate: "#6250d6", rail_gippsland: "#0b0b0b", rail_regional: "#8a8880", road_principal: "#eb6834", sea: "#1baf7a"})
modeLabel = ({road: T("Road", "公路"), rail: T("Rail", "铁路"), sea: T("Sea", "海运")})
zoneLabel = ({
  VIC_METRO: T("Vic metro levy zone", "维州大都市税区"), VIC_RURAL: T("Vic rural levy zone", "维州乡村税区"),
  NSW_MLA: T("NSW metro levy area (Sydney, Hunter, Illawarra)", "新州大都市征税区（悉尼、猎人谷、伊拉瓦拉）"), NSW_RLA: T("NSW regional levy area", "新州区域征税区"),
  NSW_NOLEVY: T("NSW, outside levy areas", "新州非征税区"), SA_METRO: T("Metro Adelaide levy area", "阿德莱德大都市税区"), SA_NONMETRO: T("SA non-metro", "南澳非大都市"),
  ACT: T("ACT (Mugga Lane all-in price)", "首都领地（Mugga Lane全包价）"), TAS: T("Tasmania", "塔斯马尼亚")
})
serviceLabel = ({fogo: T("food + garden (FOGO)", "厨余+园林（FOGO）"), go: T("garden only", "仅园林"), none: T("no organics bin", "无有机垃圾桶")})
statusLabel = ({win: T("Sends us its waste", "会交给我方"), fence: T("On the fence", "观望中"), lose: T("Too expensive", "太贵"), nodata: T("No data / out of scope", "无数据/不在范围内")})
STATUS = ["win", "fence", "lose", "nodata"]
statusColor = ({win: "#2a78d6", fence: "#eda100", lose: "#c9c7c0", nodata: "#f1f0ec"})
fmt = v => Number.isFinite(v) ? `A$${v.toFixed(0)}` : "—"
fmt1 = (v, d = 1) => Number.isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(d) : "—"
esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, ch => ({"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;"})[ch])
rich = s => { const p = document.createElement("p"); p.className = "kpi-note"; p.innerHTML = s; return p; }

//| echo: false
{
  const geoNames = new Set(geo.features.map(f => f.properties.name));
  const csvNames = new Set(councils.map(c => c.name));
  const geoOnly = [...geoNames].filter(n => !csvNames.has(n));
  const csvOnly = [...csvNames].filter(n => !geoNames.has(n));
  const noFreight = councils.filter(c => c.priced).flatMap(c => SITES.filter(s => !legsBy.get(c.name)?.get(s.id)?.length).map(s => `${c.name}→${s.id}`));
  const unknownZone = councils.filter(c => c.priced && !Number.isFinite(c.levy)).map(c => `${c.name} (${c.zone})`);
  const probs = [];
  if (missingCols.length) probs.push(T(`missing columns ${missingCols.join(", ")}`, `缺少列 ${missingCols.join("、")}`));
  if (geoOnly.length) probs.push(T(`${geoOnly.length} map areas have no data row (e.g. ${geoOnly.slice(0, 3).join(", ")})`, `${geoOnly.length}个地图区域无数据行（如${geoOnly.slice(0, 3).join("、")}）`));
  if (csvOnly.length) probs.push(T(`${csvOnly.length} councils have no map area (e.g. ${csvOnly.slice(0, 3).join(", ")})`, `${csvOnly.length}个市政无地图区域（如${csvOnly.slice(0, 3).join("、")}）`));
  if (noFreight.length) probs.push(T(`${noFreight.length} council–site pairs have no feasible freight option (e.g. ${noFreight.slice(0, 3).join(", ")})`, `${noFreight.length}个市政–厂址组合无可行运输方式（如${noFreight.slice(0, 3).join("、")}）`));
  if (unknownZone.length) probs.push(T(`no levy for ${unknownZone.slice(0, 3).join(", ")}`, `无填埋税：${unknownZone.slice(0, 3).join("、")}`));
  return probs.length ? html`<div class="placeholder data-check">${T("Data check: ", "数据检查：")}${probs.join("; ")}. ${T("Re-run work/scripts/merge.py and copy data/councils.csv, data/council_freight.csv and data/councils.geojson together.", "请重新运行 work/scripts/merge.py，并同时复制 data/councils.csv、data/council_freight.csv 和 data/councils.geojson。")}</div>` : document.createElement("span");
}

//| echo: false
// Map views: "full" (incl. Tasmania), "mainland", "vicmetro" (Vic + NSW metro levy area + ACT + metro Adelaide),
// "melgipps" only for the Latrobe site. Rebuilt when the site changes; keeps the previous choice when it is still offered.
VIEW_FORMAT = ({full: L("Full map (incl. Tasmania)", "全图（含塔斯马尼亚）"), mainland: L("Full mainland map", "大陆全图"),
  vicmetro: L("Vic + interstate metro", "维州+州外都市区"), melgipps: L("Melbourne + Gippsland", "墨尔本+吉普斯兰")})
// Remembers the user's last view choice across rebuilds of the selector (plain object, not reactive)
viewMemory = ({last: "full"})
viewof view = {
  const opts = site === "LATROBE" ? ["full", "mainland", "vicmetro", "melgipps"] : ["full", "mainland", "vicmetro"];
  const value = opts.includes(viewMemory.last) ? viewMemory.last : "full";
  const input = Inputs.radio(opts, {value, format: k => VIEW_FORMAT[k], label: L("Map view", "地图范围")});
  input.addEventListener("input", () => { viewMemory.last = input.value; });
  return input;
}
```

  const main = view === "vicmetro" ? feats.filter(f => inVicMetro(f.properties)) : feats;

  const sitePt = {type: "Feature", properties: {}, geometry: {type: "MultiPoint", coordinates: [[S.lon - 0.6, S.lat - 0.5], [S.lon + 0.6, S.lat + 0.5]]}};
  const domain = view === "mainland" ? {type: "MultiPoint", coordinates: [[128.9, -39.2], [153.7, -25.9]]}
    : view === "melgipps" ? {type: "MultiPoint", coordinates: [[144.3, -38.95], [147.9, -37.35]]}
    : view === "vicmetro" ? {type: "FeatureCollection", features: [...main, sitePt]}
    : {type: "FeatureCollection", features: feats};
  const cvScale = d3.scaleLinear([9.5, 12.5], ["#cde2fb", "#104281"]).clamp(true);
  const fillOf = p => p.status === "nodata" ? statusColor.nodata : colourBy === "status" ? statusColor[p.status] : cvScale(p.cv_mj_kg);
  const info = d => {
    if (d.status === "nodata") return `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · ${statusLabel.nodata}<br>` +
      `${d.state ?? ""}${d.zone ? " · " + (zoneLabel[d.zone] ?? d.zone) : ""}<br>` +
      `<span class="tip-dim">${esc(String(d.notes ?? T("No council kerbside tonnage.", "无市政路边垃圾吨数。")).slice(0, 180))}</span>`;
    const opts = Object.entries(d.perT).map(([m, o]) => `${modeLabel[m]} ${fmt(o.perT)}/t${o.notional ? T(" (notional)", "（示意）") : ""}`).join(", ");
    const ch = d.chosen;
    return `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · ${statusLabel[d.status]}<br>` +
      `${zoneLabel[d.zone] ?? d.zone} · ${T("levy", "税")} ${fmt(d.levy)}/t<br>` +
      `${T("Red-bin garbage", "红桶垃圾")}: ${fmt1(d.garbage_t / 1e3)} kt (${d.tonnage_status === "actual" ? T("actual", "实际") : T("estimate", "估算")}, ${esc(d.garbage_year ?? "")}) · ${fmt1(d.cv_mj_kg)} MJ/kg<br>` +
      `${T("Organics bin", "有机垃圾桶")}: ${serviceLabel[d.organics_service] ?? "—"}${d.organics_service !== "none" && Number.isFinite(d.organics_coverage) ? ` (${(d.organics_coverage * 100).toFixed(0)}% ${T("coverage", "覆盖")})` : ""}<br>` +
      `${T("Pays landfill today", "当前填埋成本")}: ${fmt(d.current)}/t (${T("gate", "处理费")} ${fmt(d.current - d.levy)} + ${T("levy", "税")} ${fmt(d.levy)})<br>` +
      `${T("To", "运至")} ${T(S.short, S.shortZh)}: ${d.tpc.toFixed(1)} t/${T("container", "箱")} · ${opts || T("no allowed option", "无可用方式")}<br>` +
      `${T("Our price", "我方价格")}: ${fmt(gateFee)} + ${d.how ? modeLabel[d.how] : "—"} ${fmt(d.delivery)} = ${fmt(d.offer)}/t · ${T("saving", "节省")} ${Number.isFinite(d.offer) ? ((d.current - d.offer) / d.current * 100).toFixed(0) + "%" : "—"} (${T("needs", "需")} ${(threshold * 100).toFixed(0)}%)<br>` +
      `${T("Highest gate fee that wins it", "可争取的最高处理费")}: ${fmt(d.maxGate)}` +
      (ch ? `<br><span class="tip-dim">${esc(String(ch.route_note).slice(0, 170))}</span>` : "") +
      (ch && ch.legal_flag === "cl71_risk" ? `<br><span class="tip-risk">${T("Legal risk: NSW proximity principle (POEO Waste Reg cl. 71, >150 km) – relies on the energy-recovery defence; legal check needed.", "法律风险：新州就近原则（POEO废物条例第71条，>150公里）——依赖能源回收抗辩，需法律核实。")}</span>` : "");
  };
  const W = 640;
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: W, height: view === "full" ? 560 : view === "melgipps" ? 400 : 500, inset: 4,
    projection: {type: "mercator", domain},
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(main, {fill: d => fillOf(d.properties), stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.5, clip: "frame"}),
      context.length ? Plot.geo(context, {fill: "#f7f6f3", stroke: "#e3e2de", strokeWidth: 0.4, clip: "frame"}) : null,
      showRoutes ? Plot.geo(net.features, {stroke: d => routeColor[d.properties.mode] ?? "#888", strokeWidth: d => ({rail_interstate: 2.4, rail_gippsland: 2.4, rail_regional: 1.2, road_principal: 1.4, sea: 1.8})[d.properties.mode] ?? 1,
        strokeDasharray: d => d.properties.mode === "sea" ? (/notional/i.test(d.properties.name) ? "2,4" : "7,4") : d.properties.mode === "road_principal" ? "4,2" : null,
        strokeOpacity: d => d.properties.mode === "sea" && /notional/i.test(d.properties.name) ? 0.6 : 0.95, strokeLinecap: "round", fill: "none", clip: "frame"}) : null,
      showRoutes ? Plot.dot(PORTS, {x: "lon", y: "lat", r: 3.5, fill: "white", stroke: routeColor.sea, strokeWidth: 2, clip: "frame"}) : null,
      Plot.dot(SITES.filter(s => s.id !== site), {x: "lon", y: "lat", r: 4, fill: "white", stroke: "#52514e", strokeWidth: 1.5, clip: "frame"}),
      Plot.text(SITES.filter(s => s.id !== site), {x: "lon", y: "lat", text: s => T(s.short, s.shortZh), dx: 7, dy: 0, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: "#52514e", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 3, clip: "frame"}),
      Plot.dot([S], {x: "lon", y: "lat", r: 8, fill: S.flag === "blocked" ? "#e34948" : "#0b0b0b", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 2, symbol: "star"}),
      Plot.text([S], {x: "lon", y: "lat", text: () => T(`Plant: ${S.short}`, `工厂：${S.shortZh}`) + (S.flag === "blocked" ? T(" (not permitted)", "（不许可）") : S.flag === "caution" ? T(" (land not confirmed)", "（用地未定）") : ""), dx: S.id === "NARROMINE" ? -11 : 11, dy: -9, textAnchor: S.id === "NARROMINE" ? "end" : "start", fontWeight: 600, fill: "#0b0b0b", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 3}),
    ]
  });
  // Hatch the "no data / out of scope" areas so they don't read as "too expensive"
  const svg = chart.tagName.toLowerCase() === "svg" ? chart : chart.querySelector("svg");
  svg.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin", `<defs><pattern id="nodata-hatch" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6" patternTransform="rotate(45)"><rect width="6" height="6" fill="${statusColor.nodata}"/><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#b8b6ae" stroke-width="1.4"/></pattern></defs>`);
  // Tooltip tied to the exact council polygon under the cursor: listeners on the FIRST geo group only
  const wrap = html`<div class="map-wrap"></div>`;
  const tip = html`<div class="map-tip" style="display:none"></div>`;
  wrap.append(chart, tip);
  const groups = chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="geo"]');
  groups.forEach((g, i) => { if (i > 0) g.style.pointerEvents = "none"; });
  chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="dot"], g[aria-label="text"]').forEach(g => g.style.pointerEvents = "none");
  const paths = groups[0].querySelectorAll("path");
  if (paths.length !== main.length) wrap.append(html`<div class="placeholder data-check">${T(`Map check: ${paths.length} shapes drawn for ${main.length} areas.`, `地图检查：${main.length}个区域只绘制了${paths.length}个。`)}</div>`);
  paths.forEach((path, i) => {
    const d = main[i].properties;
    path.setAttribute("data-name", d.name); path.setAttribute("data-status", d.status);
    if (d.status === "nodata") path.setAttribute("fill", "url(#nodata-hatch)");
    path.style.cursor = "pointer";
    path.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
      const r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      tip.innerHTML = info(d); tip.style.display = "block";
      const x = e.clientX - r.left, y = e.clientY - r.top;
      tip.style.left = `${Math.max(0, Math.min(x + 14, r.width - 290))}px`; tip.style.top = `${y + 14}px`;
      path.setAttribute("stroke", "#0b0b0b"); path.setAttribute("stroke-width", 1.5);
    });
    path.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { tip.style.display = "none"; path.setAttribute("stroke", "white"); path.setAttribute("stroke-width", 0.5); });
  });
  const sw = (c, t, extra = "") => `<span><span class="sw" style="background:${c};${extra}"></span>${t}</span>`;
  const hatch = `repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, ${statusColor.nodata} 0 3px, #b8b6ae 3px 4.5px)`;
  const legend = document.createElement("div"); legend.className = "map-legend";
  if (colourBy === "status") legend.innerHTML = ["win", "fence", "lose"].map(s => sw(statusColor[s], statusLabel[s])).join("") + sw(statusColor.nodata, statusLabel.nodata, `background:${hatch}`);
  else { legend.append(Plot.legend({color: {type: "linear", domain: [9.5, 12.5], range: ["#cde2fb", "#104281"], label: T("Red-bin energy content (MJ/kg)", "红桶垃圾热值（兆焦/千克）")}, width: 300}));
         legend.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", sw(statusColor.nodata, statusLabel.nodata, `background:${hatch}`)); }
  wrap.prepend(legend);
  if (showRoutes) { const l2 = document.createElement("div"); l2.className = "map-legend"; l2.innerHTML =
    sw(routeColor.rail_interstate, T("Interstate rail (standard gauge)", "州际铁路（标准轨）")) + sw(routeColor.rail_gippsland, T("Gippsland line (broad gauge)", "吉普斯兰线（宽轨）")) +
    sw(routeColor.rail_regional, T("Regional rail", "区域铁路")) + sw(routeColor.road_principal, T("Principal road corridors", "主要公路走廊")) +
    sw(routeColor.sea, T("Bass Strait shipping (dashed); mainland coastal lanes dotted = notional, no regular domestic container service", "巴斯海峡航运（虚线）；大陆沿海航线点线 = 示意，无定期国内集装箱航班")) +
    `<span><span class="sw" style="background:white;border:2px solid ${routeColor.sea};border-radius:50%"></span>${T("Ports", "港口")}</span>`; wrap.append(l2); }
  return wrap;
}

//| echo: false
//| output: false
gateLF = ({VIC_METRO: gVicMetro, VIC_RURAL: gVicRural, NSW_MLA: gNSWm, NSW_RLA: gNSWr, NSW_NOLEVY: gNSW, SA_METRO: gSAm, SA_NONMETRO: gSA, ACT: gACT, TAS: gTAS})
BASS = new Set(["Burnie", "Devonport", "Grassy (King Island)", "Lady Barron (Flinders Island)"])
// Cost per 20 ft container (A$) for one freight option: same formula as the freight cost table, plus the truck km already paid by the council
boxCost = r => {
  const truck = roadPerKm * Math.max(0, (r.road_km ?? 0) - localKm) + roadFix;
  const rail = railPerKm * (r.rail_km ?? 0);
  if (r.mode === "road") return truck;
  if (r.mode === "rail") return truck + rail + railFix + liftExtra * Math.max(0, r.transfers - 2);
  const bass = r.bass_strait === 1 || BASS.has(r.port);
  return truck + rail + railFix + 2 * portFix + liftExtra * Math.max(0, r.transfers - 4) + (bass ? bassRate : seaPerKm * (r.sea_km ?? 0));
}
priceFor = siteId => councils.map(c => {
  if (!c.priced) return {...c, site: siteId, status: "nodata", perT: {}, how: null, chosen: null, delivery: NaN, offer: NaN, current: NaN, maxGate: NaN, tpc: NaN};
  const current = gateLF[c.zone] + c.levy;
  // Tonnes per 20 ft container: wetter, low-energy waste compacts denser
  const density = Math.max(0.35, Math.min(0.8, rho11 + 0.05 * (11 - c.cv_mj_kg)));
  const tpc = Math.min(maxPayload, contM3 * density);
  const legs = (legsBy.get(c.name)?.get(siteId) ?? []).filter(r => modes.includes(r.mode));
  const options = legs.map(r => ({m: r.mode, r, perT: boxCost(r) / tpc, notional: /^NOTIONAL/i.test(r.route_note ?? "")}));
  const best = options.length ? options.reduce((a, b) => b.perT < a.perT ? b : a) : null;
  const delivery = best ? best.perT : Infinity;
  const offer = gateFee + delivery;
  const status = offer <= current * (1 - threshold) ? "win" : offer <= current ? "fence" : "lose";
  return {...c, site: siteId, current, density, tpc, perT: Object.fromEntries(options.map(o => [o.m, o])), how: best?.m ?? null, chosen: best?.r ?? null,
          legal: best?.r.legal_flag ?? null, delivery, offer, status, maxGate: current * (1 - threshold) - delivery};
})
rows = priceFor(site)
allSites = SITES.map(s => ({s, rows: s.id === site ? rows : priceFor(s.id)}))
byName = new Map(rows.map(d => [d.name, d]))
priced = rows.filter(d => d.status !== "nodata")
sumT = list => d3.sum(list, d => d.garbage_t)
mixCV = list => sumT(list) ? d3.sum(list, d => d.garbage_t * d.cv_mj_kg) / sumT(list) : NaN
summary = list => { const won = list.filter(d => d.status === "win"), fence = list.filter(d => d.status === "fence");
  return {won, fence, wonT: sumT(won), fenceT: sumT(fence), totT: sumT(list.filter(d => d.status !== "nodata")), cv: mixCV(won), riskT: sumT(won.filter(d => d.legal === "cl71_risk")),
          byMode: Object.fromEntries(["road", "rail", "sea"].map(m => [m, sumT(won.filter(d => d.how === m))])),
          fenceGate: fence.length ? d3.min(fence, d => d.maxGate) : null}; }
K = summary(rows)

  ${tile(T("On the fence", "观望中"), `${(K.fenceT / 1e3).toFixed(0)} kt/yr`, K.fence.length ? T(`all won at A$${Math.floor(K.fenceGate / 5) * 5}/t or less`, `处理费降至${Math.floor(K.fenceGate / 5) * 5}澳元/吨即可全部争取`) : T("none at this price", "此价格下无"))}

</div>`

  const be = name => { const d = byName.get(name); if (!d || d.status === "nodata") return null;
    const r = (legsBy.get(name)?.get(site) ?? []), rl = r.find(x => x.mode === "rail"), se = r.find(x => x.mode === "sea" && !(x.bass_strait === 1));

  const syd = be("Sydney"), adl = be("Adelaide");

Shipping pays port charges at both ends plus rail from the Port of Melbourne, so at A$${seaPerKm.toFixed(2)} per container-km sea is cheapest for ${seaWins.length} of ${mainlandSea.length} mainland councils with a sea option. Sea beats rail once coastal freight falls below about <b>${f(syd)}</b> per container-km from Sydney${adl ? ` and <b>${f(adl)}</b> from Adelaide` : ""}. Mainland coastal lanes are notional: there is no regular domestic container service on them.`,

  const order = priced.filter(d => d.status !== "lose").sort((a, b) => b.garbage_t - a.garbage_t).slice(0, 15);

    marks: [
      Plot.barX(order, {y: "name", x: d => d.garbage_t / 1e3, fill: "status", rx: 2}),
      Plot.text(order, {y: "name", x: d => d.garbage_t / 1e3, text: d => `${fmt1(d.cv_mj_kg)} MJ/kg`, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: "#52514e"}),
      Plot.tip(order, Plot.pointerY({y: "name", x: d => d.garbage_t / 1e3, title: d => `${d.name}: ${fmt1(d.garbage_t / 1e3)} kt · ${fmt1(d.cv_mj_kg)} MJ/kg · ${statusLabel[d.status]} · ${d.how ? modeLabel[d.how] : "—"}`}))
    ]
  });
}

## [Method and limits]{.en}[方法与局限]{.zh}

::: {.en}
- **Sites.** *Latrobe Valley*: former Hazelwood power station (146.393, −38.271). *Narromine*: rail-adjacent land by Narromine station; **not permitted** for thermal EfW under the NSW EfW Regulation 2022 (only West Lithgow, Parkes, Richmond Valley and Southern Goulburn-Mulwaree; NSW EPA EfW FAQ). *Port Augusta*: former Northern Power Station, Port Paterson (−32.543, 137.787); closed 2016; the site was sold to Cu-River Mining for a bulk port (InDaily, 10 May 2019) and a 270 MW battery is planned, so land is not confirmed; SA policy per EPA SA's April 2020 thermal EfW position statement (as summarised by WMRR, 6 July 2021).
- **Landfill price today** = landfill gate fee (excluding levy) + the 2026–27 levy for the council's zone: Victoria metro A\$177.19 (35 councils, EP Regulations 2021 reg 52) and rural A\$88.42; NSW metro levy area A\$180.20, regional levy area A\$103.80, and no levy elsewhere in NSW (POEO (Waste) Regulation 2014; Kyogle is outside the regional levy area from March 2024); metro Adelaide A\$171 and SA non-metro A\$85.50; Tasmania A\$70.56. The ACT has no levy and uses the Mugga Lane domestic price (A\$121.75/t incl. GST). **Adelaide Hills** is in the metro zone because 59.5% of its residents live inside the Metropolitan Adelaide boundary (ABS 2021 Census by SA1); a population-blended levy would be about A\$136/t. Victorian levy really depends on where the landfill is, so council → zone is an approximation.
- **Gate fees excluding levy** are set by contract and are not published per council. The defaults are adjustable benchmarks. City of Geelong reports that levy plus GST is 61% of its landfill cost, which implies a gate fee of about A\$100–110/t. The NSW regional levy area defaults to the NSW metro value.
- **Tonnage** is council kerbside garbage (red bin) only. It excludes C&I waste, hard waste and transfer-station drop-offs. Sources: Victoria, EPA Victoria council data 2023–24 (actual). NSW, NSW EPA Local Government Waste Data Survey 2023–24, red bin collected, matched on ABS LGA code. Kiama uses the council's own 2022–23 figure; six councils with implausibly high reported tonnes per household are estimated at 0.543 t per household with a red bin. ACT, TCCS household waste 2023–24 (80,461 t; ACT Assembly QON 055). SA, Green Industries SA sub-region residual tonnes 2022–23 split by population (estimate; GISA does not publish council tonnes). Tasmania, Launceston, Meander Valley and Glenorchy actuals; the other 26 councils use population × 0.170 t per person pooled from those three (estimate). Years differ (2021–22 to 2023–24) and are shown in each tooltip.
- **Energy content** of each red bin = typical bin composition × energy per material. Composition comes from the NSW EPA red-bin audits 2011–19, which give separate profiles for councils with a food-and-garden (FOGO), garden-only or no organics service. Each profile is blended by the share of homes with that service *in the tonnage year*. Where a council's organics yield per serviced home is well below the state median, the coverage is scaled down, because a new or partial service leaves food in the red bin. Dense inner-city councils are exempt. The ACT uses its own 2022 kerbside audit (11.51 MJ/kg). Energy per material is the typical as-discarded value (Tchobanoglous et al. 1993): food 4.7, garden 6.5, paper incl. nappies 15, other organics 16, plastics 32.6 MJ/kg; glass and metal 0; other 3.
- **Transport is costed per 20 ft container, then converted to per tonne for each council.** A sealed waste container holds about 33 m³, up to 24 t. Compacted density is tied to energy content: about 0.60 t/m³ at 11 MJ/kg and 0.05 t/m³ more for each MJ/kg less. So a council with no organics bin fills about 22 t per box and a FOGO council about 17.5 t.
- **Freight distances** come from a network model, not straight lines. Road: OpenStreetMap routes (Valhalla and OSRM) from each council's main town. Rail: Geoscience Australia operational lines, gauge-aware, with closed lines removed; containers change trains at Dynon (Melbourne) when the gauges differ. Sea: Tasmania via Burnie or Devonport to the Port of Melbourne, then rail. Mainland coastal lanes are notional. For each site, every council has up to three options (road, rail, sea). The page costs each one and uses the cheapest allowed option:
  - road = A\$3.50/km × truck km + A\$150 loading;
  - rail adds A\$1.40/km × rail km + A\$400 for the two terminal lifts + A\$150 per extra lift (gauge change, TasRail);
  - sea adds A\$350 port charges at each end, plus A\$1.10/km at sea or a flat Bass Strait rate (about A\$1,000 per container, the middle of the Tasmanian Government's A\$600–1,200 range, c. 2013 prices).
  - Councils already pay to haul about 30 km to their local landfill, so the first 30 truck km are not counted. Set that slider to 0 to get exactly the freight team's cost formula.
  - All unit costs are adjustable estimates, not quotes.
- **NSW proximity principle.** Clause 71 of the POEO (Waste) Regulation 2014 bars transporting NSW waste by road more than 150 km (straight line) from where it was generated, unless it goes to one of the two nearest lawful facilities; there is a defence for genuine energy recovery. Routes that break the 150 km test are **flagged, not blocked**: see the tooltip, the table and the "legal risk" tile. A lawyer should check them before we rely on the defence.
- **On the fence** = cheaper than landfill, but by less than the switching margin.
- **Not priced** (hatched): Unincorporated NSW, SA and Victoria, the APY and Maralinga Tjarutja lands, and Jervis Bay Territory. They have no council kerbside service or data.
:::

::: {.zh}
- **厂址。**拉筹伯谷：原Hazelwood电站（146.393, −38.271）。纳罗迈恩：纳罗迈恩车站旁临铁路用地；根据新州2022年垃圾能源化条例**不许可**建设热能垃圾发电厂（仅限West Lithgow、Parkes、Richmond Valley和Southern Goulburn-Mulwaree；新州环保局常见问题）。奥古斯塔港：原北方电站（Port Paterson，−32.543, 137.787），2016年关闭；厂址已售予Cu-River Mining建散货港（InDaily，2019年5月10日），并计划建设270兆瓦储能电池，用地未确定；南澳政策依据南澳环保局2020年4月热能垃圾发电立场声明（WMRR 2021年7月6日概述）。
- **当前填埋价格** = 填埋处理费（不含税）+ 所在税区2026–27年度填埋税：维州大都市177.19澳元（35个市政，2021年环保条例第52条）、乡村88.42澳元；新州大都市征税区180.20澳元、区域征税区103.80澳元，新州其他地区无税（2014年POEO废物条例；Kyogle自2024年3月起不属区域征税区）；阿德莱德大都市171澳元、南澳非大都市85.50澳元；塔州70.56澳元；首都领地无税，采用Mugga Lane生活垃圾价格（121.75澳元/吨，含GST）。**Adelaide Hills**归入大都市税区，因59.5%居民位于阿德莱德大都市边界内（ABS 2021年人口普查SA1）；按人口加权的税率约为136澳元/吨。维州填埋税实际取决于填埋场所在地，市政对应税区为近似。
- **不含税处理费**由合同确定，各市政未公开；默认值为可调整的基准。吉朗市称填埋税加GST占其填埋成本的61%，推算处理费约100–110澳元/吨。新州区域征税区默认值与新州大都市相同。
- **吨位**仅为市政路边红桶垃圾，不含工商业垃圾、大件垃圾及转运站自送垃圾。来源：维州为维州环保局2023–24市政数据（实际）；新州为新州环保局2023–24地方政府垃圾数据调查红桶收运量（实际，按ABS地方政府代码匹配；Kiama采用市政自报2022–23数据；6个每户吨数明显偏高的市政按每户0.543吨估算）；首都领地为2023–24 TCCS生活垃圾（80,461吨；议会质询055）；南澳为绿色产业局2022–23分区残余垃圾按人口分摊（估算，该局未公布各市政吨数）；塔州为Launceston、Meander Valley和Glenorchy实际数据，其余26个市政按人口×0.170吨估算。数据年份不同（2021–22至2023–24），悬停提示中显示。
- **热值**：各市政红桶热值 = 典型成分 × 各成分热值。成分来自新州环保局2011–19年红桶审计（FOGO、仅园林、无有机桶三类），按吨位年度的服务覆盖率加权；有机垃圾户均收集量明显低于州中位数的市政（新开或部分年度服务）按比例下调覆盖率，高密度市中心市政除外。首都领地采用其2022年路边垃圾审计（11.51兆焦/千克）。各成分热值（Tchobanoglous等，1993）：厨余4.7、园林6.5、纸（含尿布）15、其他有机物16、塑料32.6兆焦/千克，玻璃金属0，其他3。
- **运费按20英尺集装箱计算，再折算为每吨。**密封垃圾箱约33立方米，最大载重24吨；压实密度与热值挂钩：11兆焦/千克时约0.60吨/立方米，每低1兆焦/千克增加0.05。无有机桶市政每箱约22吨，FOGO市政约17.5吨。
- **运距**来自网络模型而非直线距离：公路为OpenStreetMap路线（Valhalla及OSRM，自各市政主要城镇出发）；铁路为澳大利亚地球科学局运营线路（区分轨距，已剔除停运线路，轨距不同时在墨尔本Dynon换车）；海运为塔州经伯尼或德文波特至墨尔本港再转铁路，大陆沿海航线为示意。每个厂址每个市政最多三种方式（公路、铁路、海运），页面逐一计算成本并取可用方式中最便宜者：公路 = 每公里3.50澳元 × 卡车公里 + 装箱150澳元；铁路另加每公里1.40澳元 × 铁路公里 + 两次站场装卸400澳元 + 每次额外换装150澳元（换轨、塔州铁路）；海运另加两端港口费各350澳元，以及每公里1.10澳元或巴斯海峡统一运价（约每箱1000澳元，塔州政府600–1200澳元区间中值，约2013年价格）。各市政已承担约30公里本地运距，前30卡车公里不计；将该滑块设为0即与货运组公式完全一致。所有单价均为可调整估算值，并非报价。
- **新州就近原则**：2014年POEO废物条例第71条禁止将新州垃圾经公路运至产生地150公里（直线）以外，除非运往最近的两处合法设施；真正的能源回收可作抗辩。超出150公里的路线**仅标记、不排除**（见悬停提示、表格及“法律风险”指标），依赖抗辩前需律师核实。
- **观望中**：比填埋便宜但幅度不足转换门槛。
- **不定价**（斜线）：新州、南澳及维州非建制区，APY及Maralinga Tjarutja原住民土地，杰维斯湾领地：无市政路边收运服务或数据。
:::
